title: close-up portrait
summary: A ten-second extreme close-up of a woman by a window on an overcast day: she glances right, blinks, turns slowly into profile and back. Every blink, eye movement and strand of hair is scripted to the second in the prompt.

specs.prompt: about 27,000 characters, timed second by second in 11 beats: gaze, blinks and a slow eye closure, the profile turn at 5.75 s and the turn back at 8.21 s, then a negative prompt of things to avoid
specs.input: the prompt asks the model to keep the face from a first-frame reference image
